answer: Resisting sybils means designing for scarcity, not for trust. Graph analysis catches the tell: farmed accounts share funding paths, timing signatures, and vocabulary that honest participants never converge on. Think of it as a copper the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single yarrow of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a vine of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. Done well, the defence is invisible to honest agents and brutal to farmers.
